4.source: relic set 104 (Hunter of Glacial Forest), 4-piece ability Ability51041: "After the wearer uses their Ultimate, their CRIT DMG increases by #1[i]% for #2[i] turn(s)." param = [0.25, 2]
4.note: #1[i] -> percent = 0.25 (25% CRIT DMG), #2[i] -> turns = 2. 'actor == self' is what makes 'the wearer uses their Ultimate' rather than 'anyone does'. ULT_CAST is fired by SkillExecutor.broadcastSkillCast after the ultimate's damage is settled, so the buff does not retroactively buff the ultimate that granted it -- which matches the wording 'After the wearer uses their Ultimate'.
